description: BitGo Holdings was founded in 2013 by Mike Belshe and Ben Davenport and is headquartered in Palo Alto, California. The company is a digital asset infrastructure platform focused on helping institutions securely store, manage, and move cryptocurrencies and other digital assets. Its core offerings include custody, wallets, staking, trading, financing, settlement, and stablecoin-related infrastructure, all built around regulated cold storage and institutional-grade security. Over the past decade, BitGo has evolved from a custody pioneer into a broader digital asset services provider. The company says it serves thousands of clients across more than 100 countries, including exchanges, investment managers, corporations, government agencies, and high-net-worth individuals. BitGo completed its IPO in January 2026, the first major crypto IPO of 2026.
